resources.string:
The configuration, as in a .conf file of n3n:

[community]
name = mynetwork
key = mysecret
supernode = sn.example.org:7654

[tuntap]
address = 10.1.2.3/24
Point the camera at the QR code of the configuration (made with n3n-qr)
No QR code found in that image
That QR code holds no n3n configuration
Replace the configuration with the one from the QR code?
Configuration taken over; check it, then connect
The configuration needs tuntap.address (e.g. 10.1.2.3/24): the app sets up the device with it.
